text:
Sukhino vā khemino hontu,
sabbe sattā bhavantu sukhitattā.
meaning: "May all beings be happy and safe; may their hearts be glad." The heart of the Discourse on Loving-kindness, offered to every being, near and far, seen and unseen.
purpose: To grow goodwill towards oneself, those one loves, strangers and those one finds difficult.
when: At the start or end of the day; whenever the heart is hard.
note: From the Karaṇīya Mettā Sutta (Sutta Nipāta 1.8). Loving-kindness practice is open to everyone, with or without a religious path.
name: May All Beings Be Happy (Metta)
iast:
Sukhino vā khemino hontu,
sabbe sattā bhavantu sukhitattā.
pronunciation: su-khi-no vaa khe-mi-no hon-tu; sab-bay sat-taa bha-van-tu su-khi-taat-taa
